title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Test 2 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The chart below shows the number of households in the US by their annual income in 2007, 2011 and 2015.
scenario: The chart compares the number of US households in five annual-income categories in 2007, 2011 and 2015.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Number of US households (in millions), by annual income
notes: Five bars represent the five annual-income categories for each of the three years.
